say: Welcome to Schönberg Hero. In under two minutes, you'll know how to learn your part for the next concert.
show: Welcome to Schönberg Hero. In under two minutes, you'll know how to learn your part for the next concert.

say: Start with the voice setup. First, type the code your choir gave you. It brings in your programme and your scores. No code? Just practise on your own.
show: Start with the voice setup. First, type the code your choir gave you. It brings in your programme and your scores. No code? Just practise on your own.

say: Then what?
show: Then what?

say: Sing back a little do re mi pattern, one step higher each round, then lower. That's how the app finds where your voice is comfortable. Don't push the top notes.
show: Sing back a little do-re-mi pattern, one step higher each round, then lower. That's how the app finds where your voice is comfortable. Don't push the top notes.

say: What about my Bluetooth earbuds?
show: What about my Bluetooth earbuds?

say: Wired headphones are best. The setup measures any delay: you just sing ta on each click.
show: Wired headphones are best. The setup measures any delay: you just sing “ta” on each click.

say: Now the practice screen. Your notes scroll toward the white line, and the blue line is your voice. Keep the blue line on the orange bars.
show: Now the practice screen. Your notes scroll toward the white line, and the blue line is your voice. Keep the blue line on the orange bars.

say: And the dashed boxes?
show: And the dashed boxes?

say: Those are the other voices, so you can see where you sit in the chord. The little bubble tells you how many cents sharp or flat you are.
show: Those are the other voices, so you can see where you sit in the chord. The little bubble tells you how many cents sharp or flat you are.

say: Every piece is cut into short sections, and each section climbs five levels.
show: Every piece is cut into short sections, and each section climbs five levels.

say: Level one is slow, with your part playing. Level two, full tempo. Level three, you sing alone against the other voices. Level four, no note names, only the chord to start. Level five is off book: from memory, on two different days.
show: Level 1: slow, with your part playing. Level 2: full tempo. Level 3: alone against the other voices. Level 4: no note names, only the chord to start. Level 5: off book, from memory, on two different days.

say: So level three means I'm ready for rehearsal?
show: So level 3 means I'm ready for rehearsal?

say: Exactly. Every section at three means rehearsal ready. Every section at four means concert ready.
show: Exactly. Every section at 3 = rehearsal-ready. Every section at 4 = concert-ready.

say: And when I mess up?
show: And when I mess up?

say: The coach tells you why. Sinking on long notes, late after rests, wrong notes in bar twelve. Tap the note, and it loops just those bars, slowly.
show: The coach tells you why: sinking on long notes, late after rests, wrong notes in bar 12. Tap the note, and it loops just those bars, slowly.

say: Home shows today's plan, paced to your rehearsal and concert dates. Ten minutes a day is plenty.
show: Home shows today's plan, paced to your rehearsal and concert dates. Ten minutes a day is plenty.

say: So, here's what to do right now. One: put on headphones and tap Start voice setup. Two: open the first piece on Home, and sing level one of its first section.
show: So, here's what to do right now. 1: put on headphones and tap “Start voice setup”. 2: open the first piece on Home and sing level 1 of its first section.

say: That's it?
show: That's it?

say: That's it for today. About five minutes. Tomorrow, Home shows your next step.

say: Let's sing.
